action.instructions: In this turn-based deckbuilding card battle, which single action should the player take next?

criteria.play_attack: Play an attack card when dealing damage now is the best use of energy, especially if it can kill an enemy.
criteria.play_block: Play a block card when the enemy intends to attack and the damage would hurt the player.
criteria.play_power: Play a power card with lasting effects when the enemy is not threatening much damage this turn.
criteria.use_potion: Use a potion when it prevents a lethal or very costly outcome.
criteria.end_turn: End the turn when no useful card can be played with the remaining energy.

danger.instructions: How much danger is the player in after this enemy turn if they do nothing more?
